policy.new_capability_rule: Every new kernel capability must map to one existing claim or introduce a new falsifiable claim before it is treated as research-relevant. A feature description alone is not evidence.
policy.review_policy: Reviewers must check that every claim remains falsifiable, evidence status is bounded by observed evidence, proof references resolve, and changes preserve schema compatibility or explicitly version it.

claim:accepted-behavior-controls.falsifier: A cross-tenant leak, incompatible clean merge or rewritten accepted oracle earns required readiness without executing the unchanged applicable falsifier.
claim:accepted-behavior-controls.statement: Accepted tenant and combined-interface negative controls run against the exact integrated artifact; authored positives alone never prove semantic alignment.

claim:accepted-executor-candidate-build.falsifier: A changed carrier, altered accepted executor, missing or mismatched dual-root identity, incomplete required graph, or unauthenticated artifact can establish readiness; or candidate helper changes require a separate manual build despite a supported accepted executor.
claim:accepted-executor-candidate-build.statement: For the supported remote source-CI carrier, plain validation admits candidate helper changes using an independently captured accepted executor, retains the full build/test graph and final controller verdict, and rejects substituted authority or custody.

claim:atomic-completion.falsifier: An unresolved dependency or unproven exclusive task can commit done through a direct mutation
claim:atomic-completion.statement: Every task done mutation enforces dependency and lease proof within its transaction

claim:basic-shared-optin.falsifier: The default permits such claims, the switch permits an untrusted or primary claim, stronger trust or approvals are bypassed, or success lacks a transactional use record.
claim:basic-shared-optin.statement: The default-off main-config switch allows basic agents only as secondary owners of a task with an existing different primary owner, records a policy-use event atomically, and leaves stored trust and independent policy gates unchanged.

claim:bootstrap-order.falsifier: Any generated initialization path or quickstart runs task orientation outside its governed worktree.
claim:bootstrap-order.statement: Generated entrypoints enter claimed isolated worktree before orientation and preserve orientation before implementation.

claim:bounded-escalation-admissibility.falsifier: A paraphrase, forged/stale source or cross-task continuation clears a gap; an actual required approval is inferred; a renamed subject resets the budget; reflection grants native verification/publication; or the loop persists beyond its bounded journal.
claim:bounded-escalation-admissibility.statement: The invoked escalation protocol rejects unobserved/paraphrased routine questions, preserves observed authority and canonical human dependencies, and terminates within three rounds without declaring execution or semantic exhaustion proven.

claim:bounded-integration-matrix.falsifier: A selected target or test is omitted/duplicated, compilation repeats inside shard runs, or any successful selective-test step takes 300 seconds or more.
claim:bounded-integration-matrix.statement: PR integration test execution uses one shared build and complete non-overlapping Gatling shards; every selective-test step finishes in under five minutes.

claim:bounded-preflight-latency.falsifier: A stale, missing, malformed, denied, cancelled, failed or mismatched input yields readiness; any applicable source obligation is dropped; bounded resource use is exceeded; or comparable measured collection has no material improvement.
claim:bounded-preflight-latency.statement: The collector removes repeated exact-request reads and overlaps bounded independent metadata retrieval, while preserving all exact-source and terminal custody checks; CI optimizations reduce measured critical-path overhead without skipping applicable execution.

claim:broker-caller-custody.falsifier: Required two/eight caller returned, persisted or audit identities differ; twenty concurrent mutators fail progress; physical opens recur per request.
claim:broker-caller-custody.statement: Concurrent broker requests retain originating caller context and make bounded progress through a foreground reusable connection.

claim:broker-identity-reuse.falsifier: Any of eight callers receives or persists another caller identity, storage opens per caller, uncommitted data leaks across leases, or a worker survives parent loss
claim:broker-identity-reuse.statement: Opt-in supervised physical connection reuse preserves each queued callers returned and persisted task identity

claim:broker-uncertain-lifecycle.falsifier: A post-start same-ID retry executes again, a disconnected reply ends a leader with queued work, or later callers inherit transaction/configuration state.
claim:broker-uncertain-lifecycle.statement: Lost acknowledgements never authorize mutation replay; owner loss rolls back unfinished work and releases lifecycle resources.

claim:build-layout-compatibility:questio.decision_impact: Determines whether the root lockfile remains an intentional exception to the canonical build configuration directory.
claim:build-layout-compatibility:questio.question: Should a future Bazel release permit the generated module lockfile to move under .config/build, or must it remain root-discovered?

claim:canonical-scope-projection.falsifier: Commas split literal paths, independent constraints are discarded, historical failures are erased or migration grants proof or a filesystem authorization claim.
claim:canonical-scope-projection.statement: Existing bounded task scope parser preserves JSON paths and only exact archived legacy projection fragments receive deterministic repair with history retained and approval revoked.

claim:claim:container-work-preservation.falsifier: A failed or interrupted command, local-only history, dirty tracked or untracked work, or unreadable Git status is deleted automatically; or eligible clean successful work cannot be removed.
claim:claim:container-work-preservation.statement: Automatic container workspace deletion requires successful command completion, branch foldback, verified ownership and a clean Git worktree; failed, unsynced, dirty or unverifiable work remains available with recovery diagnostics.

claim:claim:decapod-cloud-client.falsifier: Any project provider/token/price/roster requirement; direct legacy auth transport on managed init/session/TODO; cross-binding credential reuse; replay of uncertain one-time exchange/rotation; account privilege inferred locally; false ready message; leaked private credential; SQLite fallback; missing required checks or fixture results claimed as hosted evidence.
claim:claim:decapod-cloud-client.statement: Implement issue1628 client slice: logical project backend, all managed discovery/auth/account/data transport through Dactyl, repository/project/origin-bound private custody with serialized refresh and crash recovery, honest server-confirmed readiness, explicit account denial/action requirements, headless continuation and no cloud-to-SQLite fallback. Preserve local independence and existing governed publication/release dependency gates.

claim:claim:recovery-aptitude.falsifier: Unreviewed runtime or workflow changes, hand-edited generated evidence, missing current checkpoints, or a full-readiness claim based on this CI runner.
claim:claim:recovery-aptitude.statement: The candidate recovers only reviewed residual tests/documentation with newly admitted custody and actual checkpoints; historical and unrun proof remain distinct.

claim:claim:recovery-docs.falsifier: Changes outside manifest scope, hand-edited generated evidence, missing current checkpoints, or a full-readiness claim based on this CI runner.
claim:claim:recovery-docs.statement: The candidate applies only the reviewed repair scope with newly admitted custody and actual checkpoints; historical and unrun proof remain distinct. Reconcile the nine agent document indexes, run their invariant in the existing mandatory contract target, and isolate real libtest executable copying in a waited child process to prevent inherited writable descriptors. Preserve production no-retry failure semantics.

claim:committed-scope-enforcement.falsifier: A clean committed forbidden edit, deletion, rename source or over-budget delta reaches provider execution or readiness
claim:committed-scope-enforcement.statement: Full readiness rejects forbidden-path and file-budget violations across complete accepted-base candidate delta on native and provider routes

claim:complete-prepush-readiness.falsifier: An empty, stale, skipped-required, mocked-code or missing-provider result authorizes publication, or CLI/RPC/publish bypasses the same boundary
claim:complete-prepush-readiness.statement: Public validate can authorize source PR publication only after all applicable actual source checks and candidate builds pass with genuine current material/provider evidence; release-only packaging is explicitly outside core source scope

claim:config-and-policy-authority.falsifier: Actual CLI or RPC accepts unsupported config for mutation, blocks schema repair, or grants a privilege solely from an unaccepted proposal; legitimate accepted operations deadlock.
claim:config-and-policy-authority.statement: Invalid config versions deny mutation while schema references remain accessible; unaccepted root RBAC proposals cannot self-authorize and accepted scoped grants remain usable and revocable.

claim:consumer-local-proof.falsifier: Real non-Cargo failure passes, stale contract or target passes, or strict profile can downgrade
claim:consumer-local-proof.statement: Reviewed consumer local proof executes required commands against exact candidate and target without weakening strict Decapod CI proof

claim:container-boundary-integrity.falsifier: A failed execution invokes push or PR; raw gh bypasses readiness; divergent host history is overwritten; or successful cleanup deletes hidden tracked edits or new/changed stash, side branch or tag refs.
claim:container-boundary-integrity.statement: Container completion never publishes failed or local-only runs, PR requests use the common governed publisher, branch foldback rejects non-fast-forward updates, and cleanup retains index-hidden work plus refs added or changed beyond the returned branch.

claim:created-context.falsifier: A changed, unrelated, dirty, missing-base or tampered event obtains no-change status or readiness evidence
claim:created-context.statement: Only a provider-declared ordinary first push at the verified accepted target is classified as no change; actual candidate ranges remain strict

claim:current-authority-resume.falsifier: Changed source, branch lineage, intent, plan, required approval, task revision or lease owner can pass resume; or committing only checkpoint bookkeeping invalidates unchanged continuation.
claim:current-authority-resume.statement: Execution continuation checks the checkpoint against current material, accepted intent, plan, scope, policy approvals and task custody; a valid checkpoint hash alone does not grant continuation or publication readiness.

claim:current-obligation-evidence.falsifier: A required regression accepts stale cached proof, cached dependency completion, malformed requirements, dangling edges or cycles, or an unmet verify/graph command exits zero.
claim:current-obligation-evidence.statement: Obligation readiness derives from current transitive dependencies and authoritative HealthEngine evidence, not advisory caches; corrupt graphs and unmet CLI verification fail closed.

claim:current-task-proof.falsifier: A stale or unbound pass completes a work claim, unlocks dependency admission, bypasses aggregate verification, or stale verifier overwrites newer evidence
claim:current-task-proof.statement: Persisted task pass cannot authorize a different task revision, and stale verification cannot overwrite a changed baseline

claim:current-validation-withdrawal.falsifier: A newer observed required failure leaves old VERIFIED applicable, an old subject promotes after withdrawal, or fresh complete current-custody validation cannot recover after renewal.
claim:current-validation-withdrawal.statement: A newer task-bound full not-ready judgment withdraws current workunit proof, preserves historical success, and fresh current-custody proof restores legitimate VERIFIED operation.

claim:dagger-removed.falsifier: A Dagger engine can execute through the core adapter or generic receipt custody is weakened
proof_refs: PR source diff and pending remote validation
claim:dagger-removed.statement: No Dagger-specific engine execution or authorization capability remains; generic proof custody is retained

claim:durable-artifact-publication.falsifier: Parent sync failure reports success, recovery follows a substituted parent symlink, a partial history is returned as complete, or admitted append crosses its recovery size bound.
claim:durable-artifact-publication.statement: Unix atomic artifact publication requires file and containing-directory synchronization; an error after rename reports unconfirmed durability without claiming rollback, and bounded journal admission cannot append an unreadable head.

claim:fresh-provider-metadata-batching.falsifier: An invalid or denied batch falls back to another route, a metadata response is reused across invocations, changed source/provider identity passes, or batching exceeds the existing concurrency/deadline bound.
claim:fresh-provider-metadata-batching.statement: Independent current provider metadata reads use bounded authorized batches; all identity, cancellation, output-bound and final freshness checks remain mandatory.

claim:full-proof-preserved.falsifier: Any missing, failed, stale, mismatched or skipped required proof can produce readiness, or an original check command is omitted
claim:full-proof-preserved.statement: All currently applicable source checks, per-check receipts, exact-source bindings and final freshness remain required under bounded transport and same-checkout grouping

claim:gatling-full-suite-bounded-ci.falsifier: The Bazel target uses the old 300-second moderate timeout, excludes cases, disables assertions, drops or masks nonzero test exits, or allows an unbounded runtime.
claim:gatling-full-suite-bounded-ci.statement: Bazel assigns the complete //:gatling 50-case CLI test suite a finite 900-second budget without omitting any assertions, retrying failures, or changing test-thread parallelism.

claim:governance-recovery-liveness.falsifier: A tip checkpoint retroactively proves an uncheckpointed commit, an unauthorized or stale exception changes admission, or the documented supported recovery cannot reach its declared result.
claim:governance-recovery-liveness.statement: Missing immutable checkpoint evidence is precisely discoverable and has an explicit authorized recovery outcome without being reclassified as independently proven history.

claim:governed-context:question:task-cla.decision_impact: Determines routing policy and whether context selection should optimize for class-specific outcomes.
claim:governed-context:question:task-cla.question: Which task classes benefit most from narrowing, and when is additional context worth its cost?

claim:independent-entrypoint-history.falsifier: Tamper then restore to canonical HEAD can pass the full native or Buildkite readiness boundary
claim:independent-entrypoint-history.statement: Complete validation rejects unauthorized entrypoint rewrites in candidate history independently of provider-local Git gate skips

claim:intent-durability:question:sample-.decision_impact: Determines benchmark power and whether the claim can move beyond instrumented status.
claim:intent-durability:question:sample-.question: How many tasks and agent/tool combinations are needed to separate custody effects from model variance?

claim:kernel-bootstrap-custody.falsifier: Distinct independent tasks cannot author in isolated checkouts, incompatible bindings coexist, stale handoffs succeed, or missing prompt input is reported as evaluated.
claim:kernel-bootstrap-custody.statement: Independent task source overlap does not reserve a repository; task and observed checkout custody remain exclusive with fenced handoff and typed evaluation recovery.

claim:managed-project-native-routing.falsifier: A selected project is ignored, a forged or foreign account reference authorizes data, a lost creation creates another project, refresh leaves the next native request using an old bearer, or cloud denial creates local storage.
claim:managed-project-native-routing.statement: An explicitly selected managed project controls the next native data reference while current server eligibility and checkout-scoped credential custody remain intact.

claim:measured-latency-reduction.falsifier: Completed comparable successful runs do not show material reduction, or queue and overlapping timings are misrepresented
claim:measured-latency-reduction.statement: The revised collector and grouped runtime lane materially reduce comparable successful preflight costs; no five-minute claim without measurement

claim:multi-agent-custody:question:share.decision_impact: Determines whether shared-interface workflows need an additional claim, protocol, or merge proof.
claim:multi-agent-custody:question:share.question: How does custody scale when tasks intentionally share an interface or require coordinated changes across workspaces?

claim:native-diagnostic-recovery.falsifier: A diagnostic cannot identify its check and capture files, or it changes proof or readiness authority
claim:native-diagnostic-recovery.statement: Executed native checks preserve machine-readable diagnostic identity, termination and check-level errors alongside existing private output without granting readiness

claim:native-discovery-deadline.falsifier: A near-expired real Rust slow probe obtains a fresh discovery budget or launches after expiry.
claim:native-discovery-deadline.statement: Supplemental Rust discovery shares the original absolute validation deadline.

claim:native-release-owner.falsifier: The extracted owner script emits true for the sanitized importer, missing/unknown runner identity or explicit Buildkite markers, or false for the configured native hosted identity.
claim:native-release-owner.statement: Only the configured native GitHub-hosted owner identity selects release mutation; sanitized Buildkite imports and missing or unknown runner identity remain false before credential-bearing jobs.

claim:owned-native-path-authority.falsifier: Counterfeit loops or copied JSON, changed source/base/policy, revoked lease or a failed rerun can authorize current publication from an old pass.
claim:owned-native-path-authority.statement: Only current owned native authorization and actual terminal observations satisfy required path policy; full-host coverage remains unknown.

claim:pr1609-governed-publication.falsifier: Any authored commit lacks a staged-material checkpoint, governance artifact, or required generated projection; exact-candidate validation fails
claim:pr1609-governed-publication.statement: Every authored commit on the replacement PR candidate has current Decapod checkpoint lineage and current release-bound projections

claim:pr1609-source-audit.falsifier: Any finding lacks a precise source, misstates implemented behavior, or marks unexecuted runtime fixes as complete
claim:pr1609-source-audit.statement: Documentation review accurately records source-backed datastore gaps and does not claim unrun proof or implementation

claim:pr1702-current-exact-source.falsifier: A changed source, stale accepted target, missing proof or unsupported authority can be accepted as current success.
claim:pr1702-current-exact-source.statement: Current implementation preserves its stated accepted policy and boundaries on the recorded source/base; new source-CI execution is required before merge.

claim:precise-file-claims.falsifier: Disjoint basic-trust claims conflict solely on root directory, real file overlaps pass, or shared trust/policy gates weaken
claim:precise-file-claims.statement: Explicit bounded file-set scopes allow disjoint exclusive claims without promoting trust while retaining real path and independent policy conflicts

claim:project-spec-purpose.falsifier: A non-Decapod fixture acquires a Decapod or provider identity, a narrow task replaces product purpose, or supported refresh rewrites authored material.
claim:project-spec-purpose.statement: Generic specs scaffolding and context extraction preserve the configured whole-project purpose across narrow task work; all Decapod specs describe the full product.

claim:proof-backed-completion:question:p.decision_impact: Determines future validation policy and whether additional proof gates are warranted.
claim:proof-backed-completion:question:p.question: Which proof gates best predict production-relevant correctness, and how should warning-heavy but passing runs be classified?

claim:proof-before-done.falsifier: Missing or failing proof leaves task done or success event committed
claim:proof-before-done.statement: Validated completion and captured successful proof commit atomically

claim:proof-recovery-no-deadlock:questio.decision_impact: Determines whether recovery can be automatic for legacy backlogs or must return tasks to an actionable open state.
claim:proof-recovery-no-deadlock:questio.question: When a task was completed by an agent whose proof record is missing, what minimum repository-native evidence is sufficient for a later agent to recover verification without recreating the original execution context?

claim:quinn-importer-compatibility.falsifier: Any old mixed unknown or changed importer identity validates, or full proof accepts malformed source/structural evidence
proof_refs: Targeted Rust importer identity tests and full decapod validate required
claim:quinn-importer-compatibility.statement: Current Buildkite importer0.102.5 is accepted only through independently reviewed version and executable digests; old mixed and unknown tuples remain rejected

claim:recorded-blocker-parity.falsifier: A required contradiction or spec decision is ignored at one supported boundary or old approval survives material instruction revision.
claim:recorded-blocker-parity.statement: Canonical recorded blockers refuse required plan, execution, validation and publication transitions and lawful repair requires renewed acceptance.

claim:recorded-instruction-lineage.falsifier: Origin rewrite, spoofed authentication or a new actor drops or widens accepted recorded instructions or reuses stale authority.
claim:recorded-instruction-lineage.statement: Original recorded instruction and ordered provider or reported revisions remain distinct from derived interpretation and human authorization; cold readers recover the same applicable revision.

claim:recovery-workspace-artifact-lookup.falsifier: A captured file present only in the owning task workspace cannot be found at replay or a mismatched hash is accepted.
claim:recovery-workspace-artifact-lookup.statement: Verification resolves task-bound file evidence using the same task-aware workspace lookup as capture, then enforces its stored hash.

claim:regular-release-artifact.falsifier: The staged upload path is a symlink or differs in bytes from the compiled Bazel output.
claim:regular-release-artifact.statement: The release-build uploader consumes an owned regular file containing exactly the successfully built Bazel binary.

claim:release-cpus.falsifier: CPU quota/affinity is exceeded, matrix targets drift, or publication gates are broadened
claim:release-cpus.statement: Release artifact compilation uses runner-effective CPU parallelism without altering global defaults, target matrix or publication gates

claim:release-ownership.falsifier: Non-owner release changes task assignment, owners or events
claim:release-ownership.statement: A different local actor cannot release current exclusive custody

claim:release-pr-provider-parity.falsifier: An imported Buildkite job retrieves release secrets or executes a release mutation, a native release path loses its owner gate, or PR-only dispatch invokes package publishing.
claim:release-pr-provider-parity.statement: Native GitHub Actions is the sole release mutation owner; Buildkite imports skip credential-bearing release jobs and do not count as publication proof. Explicit PR-only dispatch preserves normal native push behavior.

claim:release-version-stable-bazel.falsifier: A version-only candidate fails stale-lock setup, or changed dependencies build without a reviewed lock refresh
claim:release-version-stable-bazel.statement: A version-only release with unchanged dependency resolution can build through strict Bazel setup while dependency drift remains fail-closed

claim:renewed-plan-acceptance.falsifier: A changed intent, scope, proof or phase contract retains accepted state or phase completion, or phase progression promotes an unapproved plan
claim:renewed-plan-acceptance.statement: Material plan or phase contract changes revoke previous accepted state and progress before execution can continue; no-op changes preserve state

claim:repeatable-bootstrap.falsifier: Forced init resets tracker or reviewed contract, or generated workflow lacks immutable context
claim:repeatable-bootstrap.statement: Both init entrypoints preserve omitted authored config choices; generated CI includes immutable range and full history

claim:reviewed-importer-01027.falsifier: An observed green result or arbitrary version/digest tuple authorizes import; any required proof/profile/custody check is removed; or the selected controller artifact lacks verified accepted-executor and source provenance.
claim:reviewed-importer-01027.statement: The importer accepts only independently reviewed official0.102.7 compiler/Linux/Darwin executable identities, with unchanged source, producer, recipe and artifact custody checks; older, unknown, mixed and swapped tuples remain invalid.

claim:selected-root-and-relation-conserv.falsifier: Omitted R3, duplicate or stale DB mapping, candidate policy repin or the inconsistent accepted triangle earns current readiness.
claim:selected-root-and-relation-conserv.statement: Explicit accepted selected roots map uniquely through existing obligations and supported eq/ne relations are checked globally without asserting implementation correctness.

claim:strict-protocol-rollout.falsifier: The fallback accepts altered or new carrier content after only changing the review digest, supported R failure falls back to H, or an old released executable is claimed to acquire unimplemented bootstrap behavior.
claim:strict-protocol-rollout.statement: Initial protocol rollout preserves strict independently pinned single-root compatibility, and unsupported workflow or execution contracts remain actionable blockers rather than self-authorizing a candidate controller.

claim:task-journal-reconstruction.falsifier: A supported mutation loses journal custody, replay changes verification bytes or revision, a contradictory chain is accepted, or recovery overwrites an unrelated current projection.
claim:task-journal-reconstruction.statement: Modern local task mutation and exact revision, lease, owner, dependency and proof projection checkpoints commit together in the canonical event store; recovery preserves incomplete legacy history and rejects divergent live authority.

claim:trajectory-journal-recoverability.falsifier: Changing run ID discards uncommitted failures, assumptions, blockers or Jev evidence without Git recovery
claim:trajectory-journal-recoverability.statement: Starting a different trajectory cannot replace an uncommitted governance journal through supported APIs

claim:validation-without-operator-receip.falsifier: The first checked validation push needs an operator receipt; a changed command/root/head/ref/repository inherits the seal; or unrelated write/provider restrictions are bypassed.
claim:validation-without-operator-receip.statement: Configured validation can create, fast-forward or reuse its exact governed workspace branch without asking the human for a separate local policy receipt; unrelated writes, altered requests and provider/executable denials remain blocked.

claim:vega-agent-readiness-guidance.falsifier: Failed or stale proof produces PR instructions, rejection or abstention produces PR instructions, disabled mode changes delivery authority, or boolean model output is presented as a textual defect explanation.
claim:vega-agent-readiness-guidance.statement: The optional Vega post-validation result instructs the agent: accepted current required proof and accepted Vega allow an already authorized PR; rejection requires requirement/evidence review and further work; abstention requires resolving the reported gap; failed or stale required proof always requires repair and revalidation. No result grants merge or release authority.

claim:vega-current-run-scientific-collec.falsifier: Missing/replayed/mixed/unsafe/malformed phases, altered frozen inputs/labels, inconsistent decisions, numerical disagreement, failed adverse controls, absent positive coverage, hidden oracle mismatches or an abstaining verdict permit publication readiness.
claim:vega-current-run-scientific-collec.statement: Eight reviewed Rust runs preserve three fixed numerical fixtures and six pairs of fixed production-path functional cases. The mandatory current-run aggregate rechecks identity, exports, raw response interpretation, every adverse/control result and genuine positive approval on each backend. Original oracle agreement is reported separately from delegated safe-abstention qualification; collection alone never authorizes publication.

claim:vega-late-report-failure.falsifier: A late final-report filesystem error leaves ready=true, exit_code0 or create_authorized_pr instructions, overwrites existing evidence, or loses unsupported-controller recovery guidance.
claim:vega-late-report-failure.statement: Every validation execution error revokes publication readiness and PR guidance, including final verdict write or sync failure after completed proof and accepted Vega; completed proof and earlier evidence remain diagnostic only.

claim:vega-native-acceptance.falsifier: Publication occurs without complete current source/native/numerical/functional proof, without positive approval on both backends, with unsafe adverse outcomes, or by presenting agent-authored functional labels as independently calibrated domain accuracy.
claim:vega-native-acceptance.statement: Current functional delivery requires actual native Metal/CPU inference, unchanged separate Rust numerical comparisons, installation/fallback checks, meaningful model approvals and safe negative/uncertain controls. Maintainer-authorized qualification supersedes the prior research prerequisite without passing it; all old failures and domain-accuracy limits remain preserved.

claim:vega-package-input-lock.falsifier: Bazel still rejects the normalized Cargo manifest input, dependencies/required checks are changed to hide the mismatch, the lock exceeds existing discovery bounds, or metadata regeneration is represented as executed tests.
claim:vega-package-input-lock.statement: The reviewed crate packaging exclusion is reflected by normal Bazel module metadata regeneration; only the normalized Cargo.toml input hash changed, without dependency additions, expanded discovery limits or weakened checks.

claim:vega-plan-obligations.falsifier: An explicit deferred obligation, phase acceptance gate or adverse plan fact disappears from the assessment; overflow produces a partial assessment instead of abstention; stale governance authorizes publication.
claim:vega-plan-obligations.statement: The bounded post-validation assessment preserves declared proof hooks, unresolved questions, contradictions, stop conditions and phase gates as well as intent; none is silently omitted or truncated to fit model input.

claim:vega-positive-singleton.falsifier: A disabled or repinned accepted required policy, failed/stale check, adverse projection omission, changed binding, negative/ambiguous/OOD/abstaining result can establish readiness.
claim:vega-positive-singleton.statement: Required vega may permit readiness only after deterministic proof and exact freshness, accepted policy integrity and a positive singleton yes without abstention/OOD; failed, stale, uncertain or changed identities remain blocked.

claim:vega-production-projection-evaluat.falsifier: Replay uses another prompt builder, drops adverse obligations, dispatches on failed/stale/missing proof, accepts malformed responses, invents executed checks, hides oracle disagreements or authorizes publication from unsigned fixture evidence.
claim:vega-production-projection-evaluat.statement: Live assessment and replay share validation-results.v3 projection, request/response checks and the final readiness predicate. Complete deterministic proof precedes inference. Fixed functional observations come from executed bounded candidate checks but unsigned replay never grants custody or publication. Exposed v2 and zero-unit research admission stay historical, not passing accuracy or current research prerequisites.

claim:vega-public-review-source-audit.falsifier: Audit leaks selected verdict/rationale or future checks into input, labels wrong-commit/edited requirements as eligible, equates variants with independent ground truth, suppresses native checks, or claims historical statistical qualification passed.
claim:vega-public-review-source-audit.statement: Historical public review records remain pinned/audited Rust diagnostic inputs, not a qualified readiness study. Review verdicts/rationale, future CI, conflicting identities and incomplete source histories cannot become independent readiness truth. Maintainer-authorized functional qualification does not claim that the old study or risk criterion passed.

claim:vega1445-readiness-role-qualificat.falsifier: Qualification passes an always-abstaining/rejecting model, lacks approval on either backend, accepts unmet obligations/manipulation, accepts malformed inference, hides an oracle mismatch, changes model/input/threshold/tolerances, or grants readiness to failed/stale/abstaining work.
claim:vega1445-readiness-role-qualificat.statement: The maintainer replaced the statistical qualification with functional integration and delegated safe-abstention interpretation. Both actual backends must approve meaningful ready work; every adverse/control case and numerical comparison must pass. A ready control may validly abstain, preserving its frozen expected-accept mismatch and blocking that assessed work. Domain accuracy and old research success remain unestablished.

claim:version-storage-independence.falsifier: Version fails on damaged or unsafe storage, writes project state, or consumes migration notice; stateful commands accept unsafe permissions
claim:version-storage-independence.statement: System version reports binary metadata without opening project state, while stateful commands retain unsafe-permission rejection and migration notices

claim:workunit-journal-recovery.falsifier: Concurrent mutations lose updates, stale prepared state overwrites the journal, a retry overwrites a divergent projection, or replay refreshes a retained passing proof artifact.
claim:workunit-journal-recovery.statement: Workunit generation-fenced mutations have durable event snapshots before JSON publication; interrupted projection publication is explicitly recoverable without inventing current proof.
